articles.title: 最高检通报马兴瑞涉嫌受贿案已提起公诉
articles.summary: 最高检通报马兴瑞案调查终结、移送审查起诉并指定宜昌市检察院办理，宜昌市检察院已向宜昌中院提起公诉。
articles.new_facts: 最高检11月5日通报马兴瑞涉嫌受贿案已由国家监委调查终结并移送审查起诉；最高检作出逮捕决定并指定宜昌市检察院审查起诉；宜昌市检察院已向宜昌中院提起公诉。
articles.limitations: 最高检通报内容由中新社转述，未直接取得最高检原文；起诉指控尚待法院审理。

facts.text: 中新社报道，最高人民检察院11月5日通报，中共中央政治局原委员马兴瑞涉嫌受贿案已由国家监察委员会调查终结，移送检察机关审查起诉；最高检以涉嫌受贿罪对其作出逮捕决定，并指定湖北省宜昌市人民检察院审查起诉。

evidence.quote: 中国最高人民检察院5日通报，中共中央政治局原委员、中央农村工作领导小组原副组长马兴瑞涉嫌受贿案，由国家监察委员会调查终结，移送检察机关审查起诉。
最高检以涉嫌受贿罪对马兴瑞作出逮捕决定，并指定由湖北省宜昌市人民检察院审查起诉。

facts.text: 宜昌市人民检察院近日已向宜昌市中级人民法院提起公诉。起诉指控马兴瑞利用在航天科技集团、广东省委、深圳市委、广东省政府及中央政治局等任职便利，为他人谋利，非法收受财物数额特别巨大。

evidence.quote: 宜昌市人民检察院近日已向宜昌市中级人民法院提起公诉。
被告人马兴瑞利用担任中国航天科技集团公司党组成员、副总经理、党组书记、总经理，广东省委副书记、深圳市委书记，广东省委副书记、省长，中共中央政治局委员等职务上的便利以及职权或者地位形成的便利条件，为他人谋取利益，非法收受他人财物，数额特别巨大

bilingual.title_en: Top procuratorate announces public prosecution of former Politburo member Ma Xingrui in bribery case

sentences.en: China News Service reported that the Supreme People's Procuratorate said on November 5 that the investigation into the suspected bribery case against Ma Xingrui, a former member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, had been concluded by the National Commission of Supervision and transferred to procuratorial organs for examination and prosecution; the Supreme People's Procuratorate decided to arrest him on suspicion of accepting bribes and designated the Yichang Municipal People's Procuratorate in Hubei Province to examine and prosecute the case.
sentences.zh: 中新社报道，最高人民检察院11月5日通报，中共中央政治局原委员马兴瑞涉嫌受贿案已由国家监察委员会调查终结，移送检察机关审查起诉；最高检以涉嫌受贿罪对其作出逮捕决定，并指定湖北省宜昌市人民检察院审查起诉。

sentences.en: The Yichang Municipal People's Procuratorate recently filed a public prosecution with the Yichang Intermediate People's Court.
sentences.zh: 宜昌市人民检察院近日已向宜昌市中级人民法院提起公诉。

sentences.en: The prosecution alleges that Ma took advantage of his positions at China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, in the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, the CPC Shenzhen Municipal Committee and the Guangdong Provincial Government, and in the Political Bureau, among others, to seek benefits for others and illegally accepted an especially huge amount of property.
sentences.zh: 起诉指控马兴瑞利用在航天科技集团、广东省委、深圳市委、广东省政府及中央政治局等任职便利，为他人谋利，非法收受财物数额特别巨大。

articles.event_key: 黄之锋|被判刑|国安法案件
articles.title: 黄之锋因国安法案件被判十年监禁
articles.summary: BBC报道，黄之锋因国安法下勾结外国势力罪被判十年监禁，新刑期部分与现有刑期同期执行。
articles.new_facts: 黄之锋11月5日因国安法下勾结外国势力罪被判十年监禁；他此前因颠覆罪服刑，原定明年1月获释；新刑期中2个月2天与现有刑期同期执行；控方称其2020年与罗冠聪等人串谋游说外国制裁和封锁北京；他已于9月认罪。
articles.limitations: 仅依据BBC报道，未取得判决书；刑期执行细节以报道为准。

facts.text: BBC报道，香港活动人士黄之锋因国安法下“勾结外国势力”罪被判十年监禁。判决于11月5日作出；他此前因颠覆罪服刑，原定明年1月获释，新刑期中2个月2天与现有刑期同期执行。

evidence.quote: Joshua Wong, once the face of Hong Kong's democracy movement, has been sentenced to 10 years in jail for colluding with foreign forces under the city's sweeping national security law.
Having already spent the last six years in jail, Wong, who was due to be freed in January, will now spend another decade behind bars.
Two months and two days of the 10-year term will be served concurrently with his ongoing sentence, the judge said on Thursday.

facts.text: 控方称，黄之锋2020年7月至11月与罗冠聪等人串谋，游说外国对北京实施制裁和封锁；他已于9月认罪。

evidence.quote: Prosecutors said that Wong had conspired with other campaigners, including self-exiled activist Nathan Law, to lobby for foreign sanctions and blockades against Beijing.
These activities took place between July and late November 2020, the court heard.
which he has pleaded guilty to earlier in September

bilingual.title_en: Joshua Wong Sentenced to Ten Years in National Security Law Case

sentences.en: The BBC reported that Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to ten years in prison on a charge of "colluding with foreign forces" under the national security law.
sentences.zh: BBC报道，香港活动人士黄之锋因国安法下“勾结外国势力”罪被判十年监禁。

sentences.en: The sentence was handed down on November 5; he had been serving a term for subversion and had been due for release in January next year, with two months and two days of the new term to run concurrently with his existing sentence.
sentences.zh: 判决于11月5日作出；他此前因颠覆罪服刑，原定明年1月获释，新刑期中2个月2天与现有刑期同期执行。

sentences.en: Prosecutors said Wong conspired with Nathan Law and others between July and November 2020 to lobby foreign countries to impose sanctions and a blockade on Beijing; he pleaded guilty in September.
sentences.zh: 控方称，黄之锋2020年7月至11月与罗冠聪等人串谋，游说外国对北京实施制裁和封锁；他已于9月认罪。

articles.title: 泽连斯基称俄军袭击学校已致40人死亡
articles.summary: 《卫报》直播报道称，泽连斯基表示俄罗斯对一所学校的袭击已确认造成40人死亡。
articles.new_facts: 泽连斯基称俄罗斯对一所学校的袭击已确认造成40人死亡，并称袭击“疯狂”。
articles.limitations: 仅依据《卫报》直播标题，未取得完整报道或独立核实。

facts.text: 《卫报》直播报道称，乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，俄罗斯对一所学校的袭击已确认造成40人死亡，并称这次袭击“疯狂”。死亡数字来自乌方。

evidence.quote: Zelenskyy says 40 now confirmed dead after ‘insane’ Russian attack on school – as it happened

bilingual.title_en: Zelensky Says Russian Strike on School Kills 40

articles.event_key: 巴西|参议院通过公共安全宪法修正案|不降低刑事责任年龄
articles.title: 巴西参议院将降低刑事责任年龄提案移出议程
articles.summary: 巴西参议院议长阿尔科伦布雷将降低刑事责任年龄提案移出4日议程，等待众议院讨论。
articles.new_facts: 巴西参议院议长阿尔科伦布雷11月4日将降低刑事责任年龄提案移出议程，应众议院议长莫塔请求，将等待众议院讨论并承诺11月内表决；参议院3日已通过未含该内容的公共安全宪法修正案。
articles.limitations: 依据巴西通讯社报道，未取得参议院表决文件。

facts.text: 巴西通讯社报道，巴西参议院议长阿尔科伦布雷11月4日将一项把刑事责任年龄从18岁降至16岁的宪法修正案提案移出当天议程，称应众议院议长莫塔请求，将等待众议院在特别委员会讨论，并承诺11月内表决。此前参议院3日通过公共安全宪法修正案，未包含降低刑责年龄内容。

evidence.quote: O presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), retirou da pauta desta quarta-feira (4) a proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) que reduz a maioridade penal de 18 anos para 16 anos.
Alcolumbre disse que atendeu a um pedido do presidente da Câmara, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB). Agora, caberá à Câmara dos Deputados debater o tema em uma comissão especial.
A articulação envolveu a retirada da discussão sobre a redução da maioridade penal do texto da PEC da Segurança Pública (PEC18/2025), que foi aprovada ontem (3).

bilingual.title_en: Brazil Senate Removes Bill to Lower Criminal Responsibility Age From Agenda

sentences.en: Brazil's Senate President Davi Alcolumbre removed from that day's agenda on November 4 a proposed constitutional amendment to lower the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, saying at the request of Chamber of Deputies Speaker Arthur Lira that it would wait for the Chamber to discuss it in a special committee and pledging a vote within November, Agência Brasil reported.
sentences.zh: 巴西通讯社报道，巴西参议院议长阿尔科伦布雷11月4日将一项把刑事责任年龄从18岁降至16岁的宪法修正案提案移出当天议程，称应众议院议长莫塔请求，将等待众议院在特别委员会讨论，并承诺11月内表决。

sentences.en: The Senate had previously passed a public security constitutional amendment on November 3 that did not include provisions to lower the age of criminal responsibility.
sentences.zh: 此前参议院3日通过公共安全宪法修正案，未包含降低刑责年龄内容。
